newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wah Tak Fung ends debut below IPO price.
newsitem.headline: Wah Tak Fung ends debut below IPO price.

text.p: Wah Tak Fung Holdings Ltd failed to muster much buying interest on its stock market debut on Monday, with its shares ending below their issue price on concerns about the company's earnings outlook, analysts said.

The Hong Kong based property group offered 138 million new shares at HK$1.88 per share and the flotation was 10.6 times subscribed. The shares opened at HK$1.92 on Monday, their highest level of the day, and closed at HK$1.72.
"Relative to other IPOs, the subscription rate was not that much at all. Wah Tak Fung does not offer a promising outlook," said Sunny Chan, senior research manager at Seapower Securities.
Recent issue Glorious Sun Enterprises Ltd's initial public offering was 236 times subscribed and bus line operator Kwoon Chung Bus Holdings Ltd's flotation was 53.5 times subscribed.
Chan said Wah Tak Fung lacked focus on how it would replenish its land bank.
"It can't sustain good earnings growth," added another analyst.
